prompt: Build an immutable 2x2 matrix class with multiplication, a determinant, a static identity factory, and a "[a b; c d]" toString.
explanation: The class stores its four entries in private final fields set once by the constructor, making instances immutable: times computes the four products of the 2x2 multiplication formula and returns a brand-new Matrix2 instead of mutating this. identity() is a static factory -- it belongs to the class, not to any instance, and callers reach it as Matrix2.identity(). Overriding toString gives every matrix a readable form that the tests (and debuggers) can rely on.
hints: Declare private final double a, b, c, d and assign them with this.a = a; ... in the constructor.
times can read other.a, other.b, etc. directly -- private fields are visible between two objects of the same class. Build the four new entries and pass them to new Matrix2(...).
identity() is static, so it cannot use fields; it simply returns new Matrix2(1, 0, 0, 1). For toString, concatenate the fields: "[" + a + " " + b + "; " + c + " " + d + "]".
